description: Search LiveSpot for upcoming events across Sweden. Use this when the user asks what's on, what events are happening, what to do, or anything about concerts, sport, theatre, or shows in a Swedish city. Supports free-text, city, category, date range, and max price. `query` matches event titles, so pass only the name you are looking for ("Bamse", "Djurgården") and express everything else as filters - a sentence like "concerts in Stockholm this weekend" matches no title. Returns a paginated markdown list of events where each title links to livespot.se. Preserve the markdown links when summarizing so users can click through. City slugs are ASCII (goteborg, malmo); Swedish characters are normalized automatically (å/ä→a, ö→o).

category.description: Category slug. Accepts Swedish or English: konsert/concert, teater/theatre, humor/comedy, etc.

city.description: City slug in ASCII (goteborg, malmo, stockholm). Swedish characters are replaced: å/ä→a, ö→o.

endDate.description: Include only events on or before this date.

limit.description: Results per page. Defaults to 10 to keep payloads under ~100KB.

maxPrice.description: Upper bound on price_min, in SEK.

query.description: Event title to look for ("Metallica", "Bamse", "Djurgarden"). This matches the event name only, so put the city, dates and price in their own fields rather than in a sentence here.

startDate.description: Include only events on or after this date.

name: search_events

slug.description: URL slug; the last 8 chars work as a short id.

source.description: Ticketing provider the listing came from.

start_time_tbd.description: True when only the day is known.

title: Search events
